card.name: Words just before a drug's name
card.fires_on: Linking words (of, with, including, and) or the first piece of a brand name, right before a specific drug name such as fingolimod, cladribine or a capitalized brand name. Found in drug-label warnings and interaction text.

modes.label: Linking word before drug
modes.description: A small word like of, with, including or and sits right before the name of the drug being discussed.

modes.label: Start of brand name
modes.description: The first letter piece of an uppercase brand name, such as Y in YARTEMLEA, YUPELRI or YERVOY.
modes.example: Serious and life-threatening infections have occurred in patients treated with<< Y>>ARTEMLEA.

card.writes: It seems to push toward rare name-starting pieces and away from other name continuations, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word or letter just before a drug name is spelled out.
